evidence: Judged "For guiding" over "The Guide can be you too, just a calmer you... A wise tradition (like "What would Jesus do?" or "What would Buddha do?") can give some direction, too, until you develop your own internal compass.": it names the function the paragraph covers (the Guide, borrowed from a calmer you, a wise person you respect, or a wise tradition) and adds no claim. It is terse, but read after "For warmth" and "For protecting" under "Borrow One Competency at a Time" it completes the same phrase (borrow someone for guiding), and the paragraph's first line "The Guide can be you too" answers it at once; "too" and "your future healed self" lean on the intro's list of figures, which is in view in the section. The shared stem ("guiding" / "The Guide") is the label doing its job, so I find T26 not happening; no other tell row is present, there are no linter findings, and the three "For" headings follow Joel's own three competency paragraphs rather than adding a taxonomy of their own.
